svg.title: Search sessions: first action to outcome
svg.desc: Illustrative counts. Of 10,000 search sessions, 5,800 start with an organic click, 1,400 with an ad click and 2,800 with no click. Half of the ad clicks (700 of 1,400) end in a reformulated query, against about one in five organic clicks (1,200 of 5,800). Of the no-click sessions, 800 end satisfied on the results page itself.
svg.text: Search sessions: first action to outcome
Highlighted: Search sessions → Ad click → Reformulated
